tools.name: nl_search
tools.description: Search playlists in the library by keyword. Matches against title, emoji, and session context.

query.description: Search keyword to match against title, emoji, or context

tools.name: nl_voices
tools.description: List available voices for rendering. Returns voice ID, name, gender, accent, and tier. Voices are used with nl_render_configure.

accent.description: Filter by accent (e.g. US, UK, AU)

tools.name: nl_sync_affirmations
tools.description: Declarative edit of affirmations in a playlist. Provide the complete desired list — affirmations not in the list are removed, new ones are added, existing ones are updated. Each affirmation needs text and enabled status. Include id for existing affirmations to preserve them. Use this when you only need to change affirmations via a JSON array. Use nl_playlist_import instead when you need to update the whole playlist (title, emoji, render config, AND affirmations) from a single YAML document.

tools.name: nl_render_configure
tools.description: Configure render settings for a playlist. Must be done before starting a render. Use nl_voices to find available voice IDs.

sessionContext.description: Session context for pacing and tone

backgroundAudioPath.description: Background sound storageKey (from nl_voices background list), or null to disable

playAll.description: Play all affirmations instead of fitting within duration

tools.name: nl_render_start
tools.description: Start rendering audio for a playlist. The set must have a render config (use nl_render_configure first). Returns a job ID for tracking progress.

tools.name: nl_render_status
tools.description: Check the render progress of a playlist. Returns status (none, queued, processing, completed, failed) and progress percentage.

tools.name: nl_rerender
tools.description: Re-render a playlist with its current config. Convenience wrapper that starts a new render job.

tools.name: nl_play
tools.description: Download rendered audio for a playlist and return the local file path. The audio must be fully rendered first (status: completed). The file is cached locally for future use.

tools.name: nl_share
tools.description: Generate a public share link for a playlist. Anyone with the link can view and copy it.

tools.name: nl_unshare
tools.description: Revoke the share link for a practice set. The link will no longer work.

id.description: Practice set ID (full or short prefix)

tools.name: nl_credits
tools.description: Check the current credit balance. Shows subscription credits, purchased credits, and total available.

tools.name: nl_guide
tools.description: Render the framework (methodology, principles, sources, groupings, practical application, takeaway) for a playlist as markdown. Returns a clean fallback message for legacy sets that do not carry a framework — never errors on missing framework.

tools.name: nl_user_profile
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's profile including username, display name, email, subscription tier, credit balance, and role.

tools.name: nl_user_set_username
tools.description: Set or update the authenticated user's username. Usernames must be 3-30 characters, alphanumeric with underscores/hyphens. Returns the updated username and display name.

tools.name: nl_user_check_username
tools.description: Check if a username is available. Returns availability status and a suggested alternative if the username is taken.

tools.name: nl_catalog_browse
tools.description: Browse the curated catalog of playlists. Supports filtering by category, session context, and sorting. Returns metadata for each catalog item including title, description, category, audio availability, and duration.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default: 20)

offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination (default: 0)

tools.name: nl_catalog_view
tools.description: View a specific catalog item by slug. Returns full details including affirmations, framework, inspirations, voice info, and render configuration.

tools.name: nl_catalog_copy
tools.description: Copy a catalog playlist to the user's library. Creates a full copy including affirmations, render config, and pre-rendered audio. The new playlist appears in nl_playlist_list immediately.

slug.description: Catalog item slug (from nl_catalog_browse or nl_catalog_view)

tools.name: nl_affirmations_feedback
tools.description: Set feedback (like or dislike) on one or more affirmations in a playlist. Supports batch: provide multiple affirmation IDs. Uses continue-on-error — partial failures are reported per-affirmation. Use null feedback to clear.

affirmationIds.description: Affirmation IDs to set feedback on (use nl_playlist_view to find IDs)

feedback.description: Feedback value: 'liked', 'disliked', or null to clear

tools.name: nl_affirmations_toggle
tools.description: Enable or disable one or more affirmations in a playlist. Supports batch: provide multiple affirmation IDs. All toggles are applied atomically in a single transaction.

affirmationIds.description: Affirmation IDs to toggle (use nl_playlist_view to find IDs)

isEnabled.description: true to enable, false to disable

tools.name: nl_context_settings_list
tools.description: List all per-context default settings (voice, duration, binaural, pace, background, etc.). Returns customized contexts only — contexts not listed use system defaults.

tools.name: nl_context_settings_update
tools.description: Update default settings for a specific session context. Set individual fields to override system defaults. Set a field to null to clear that override.

context.description: Session context to update defaults for

voiceId.description: Default voice ID for this context (null to clear)

durationMinutes.description: Default duration in minutes (null to clear)

binauralPreset.description: Default binaural beat preset. "off" stores an explicit Off choice; null clears the override so the context default applies

paceWpm.description: Default pace in words per minute (null to clear)

backgroundKey.description: Default background sound key (null to disable)

subliminalEnabled.description: Whether subliminal layer is enabled by default (null to clear)

repeatCount.description: Default repeat count per affirmation (null to clear)

pauseMs.description: Default pause between affirmations in ms (null to clear)

tools.name: nl_context_settings_reset
tools.description: Reset a context's settings to system defaults. Removes all custom overrides for the specified context.

tools.name: nl_wizard_defaults
tools.description: Get the resolved wizard defaults (voice, background, binaural, duration, playback mode). Returns the effective defaults based on a 4-level cascade: intent-specific config > recent config > onboarding preferences > system defaults.

intentId.description: Optional intent ID to resolve intent-specific defaults from

tools.name: nl_source_extract
tools.description: Extract text preview from a URL (article, blog post, etc.). Returns title, author, character count, and excerpt. Useful for previewing source material before feeding it into nl_playlist_create.

url.description: URL of the web page to extract text from

tools.name: nl_source_youtube
tools.description: Extract transcript from a YouTube video URL. Returns title, channel name, character count, and video ID. The transcript can then be used as source material with nl_playlist_create.

tools.name: nl_source_twitter
tools.description: Extract thread text from a Twitter/X post URL. Returns the post text, author name, handle, and character count. The text can then be used as source material with nl_playlist_create.

tools.name: nl_source_pdf
tools.description: Upload a local PDF file and extract its text content. Returns the extracted text, page count, and character count. The text can then be used as source material with nl_playlist_create. Maximum file size is 10 MB.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the PDF file on the local filesystem

tools.name: nl_playback_start
tools.description: Log the start of a practice session (playback). Creates a playback history record for the given playlist. The playlist must exist in the user's library. Optionally accepts a render job ID for analytics. Returns the playback record ID for use with nl_playback_complete.

renderJobId.description: Render job ID for analytics tracking (optional)

tools.name: nl_playback_complete
tools.description: Update a playback session with completion status. Records the duration in seconds and optionally marks the session as completed. Use the playback ID returned by nl_playback_start.

durationSeconds.description: Duration of the playback session in seconds

completed.description: Whether the session was fully completed (default: false)

tools.name: nl_generate_more
tools.description: Generate additional affirmations for an existing playlist using AI. Adds new affirmations alongside the existing ones. Costs 1 credit. The count parameter is only honored for free regeneration (replacing removed affirmations); paid generation uses the server default batch size.

count.description: Number of affirmations to generate (only honored for free regeneration; paid uses server default)

tools.name: nl_affirmation_add
tools.description: Add a custom user-written affirmation to a playlist. The affirmation text must be 1-240 characters.

tools.name: nl_affirmation_delete
tools.description: Delete a single affirmation from a playlist. Cannot delete if it would leave fewer than 5 non-disliked enabled affirmations.

affirmationId.description: ID of the affirmation to delete (use nl_playlist_view to find IDs)

tools.name: nl_coaches
tools.description: List all available coaches with their summaries. Each coach carries a proper name and role label (e.g. "Cole, the Head Coach"), a tagline in the coach's own register, an angle line naming what that coach brings to your intent, a stance, filtered identity-kit keywords, description, inspiredBy, signature voice, default tone, and voice perspective. Also indicates which coach you last generated with. Requires the coaches feature to be enabled.

tools.name: nl_coach_view
tools.description: View full details for a specific coach by key. Returns the coach's proper name, role label, tagline, stance, what it is best for and wrong for, description, inspiredBy exemplars, signature voice, default tone, voice perspective, and visual metadata. Requires the coaches feature to be enabled.

key.description: The coach key to look up. One of: cole (Cole, the Head Coach), nia (Nia, the Mentor), theo (Theo, the Scientist), ilana (Ilana, the Visionary).

tools.name: nl_user_settings_update
tools.description: Update user profile settings. Set your tone preference. Pass null to clear a setting (tonePreference=null resets to the coach default). The coach is not a stored setting — pass coachKey to nl_playlist_create to pick one per playlist; the coach you generate with is remembered as your last used.

tonePreference.description: Tone preference: 'grounded', 'open', 'mystical', or null to use coach default

tools.name: nl_playlist_list
tools.description: List all playlists in the user's library with metadata including title, emoji, context, affirmation count, render status, play count, and last played date.

tools.name: nl_playlist_view
tools.description: View a specific playlist with its affirmations, render status, and play statistics. Shows each affirmation's text, enabled status, and feedback (liked/disliked). Accepts full or short ID.

tools.name: nl_playlist_create
tools.description: Create a new playlist. Provide intent text, source material (from a book, article, PDF, etc.), your own affirmations, or a combination. When source is provided, AI generates affirmations grounded in that material — costs 1 credit. When affirmations is provided, the playlist is created directly from your text with NO generation and NO credit charge (source/style/styleNotes/coachKey are ignored in this mode).

text.description: Intent text describing what you want to practice (e.g. "I am confident and capable"). Optional when sourceText is provided; required when affirmations is provided (used as the playlist's intent).

title.description: Playlist title. Only used when affirmations is provided (the manual-creation path) — ignored during AI generation, where the title is derived from the generated content. Defaults to the first 120 characters of text when omitted.

tone.description: Tone preference: grounded (default), open, or mystical

sourceText.description: Source material text (from a book, article, podcast transcript, etc.). When provided, affirmations are generated grounded in this material. Intent text becomes optional. Ignored when affirmations is provided.

sourceTitle.description: Title of the source material (e.g. book title, article headline). Ignored when affirmations is provided.

sourceAuthor.description: Author of the source material. Ignored when affirmations is provided.

sourceUrl.description: URL of a web article. Server extracts the article text automatically. Mutually exclusive with sourceText and sourcePdf. Ignored when affirmations is provided.

sourcePdf.description: Absolute file path to a PDF document. Server extracts text automatically. Max 10 MB, 20 pages. Mutually exclusive with sourceText, sourceUrl, and sourceYoutube. Ignored when affirmations is provided.

sourceYoutube.description: YouTube video URL. Server extracts the transcript (captions) automatically. Mutually exclusive with sourceText, sourceUrl, and sourcePdf. Ignored when affirmations is provided.

style.description: Named style archetype to steer the writing style (rhetorical cadence only — no quotes or impersonation). Choose one: 'cole' — The Head Coach: Disciplined ownership and calm authority — demanding, never degrading. 'nia' — The Mentor: Sees you, and believes you before the evidence comes in. 'theo' — The Scientist: Tells you why it's working. Warm-curious, evidence-shaped, in your corner. 'ilana' — The Visionary: Poetic, metaphor-rich, paradoxical — image-dense and flowing. Combine with styleNotes to override individual dials. Ignored when affirmations is provided.

styleNotes.description: Free-form rhetorical-style dials to fine-tune the writing style. Recognized keys: sentenceLength, ideaDensity, paradox, directness, register, structurePatterns (each a short phrase). When combined with 'style', these keys override the preset. Each value max 200 chars. Ignored when affirmations is provided.

coachKey.description: Per-generation coach override. When set (and the coaches feature is enabled for you), this coach's bundle (writing style + voice perspective) applies to THIS playlist only, overriding your default coach. Use it to compare coaches on the same intent without changing your default. One of: cole (Cole, the Head Coach), nia (Nia, the Mentor), theo (Theo, the Scientist), ilana (Ilana, the Visionary) — an unrecognized key is rejected with the valid options named, never silently substituted. Not saved — affects this generation only. Ignored when affirmations is provided.

affirmations.description: Your own affirmation texts (1-240 chars each, max 45 total). When provided, the playlist is created directly from these — skips AI generation and the credit charge entirely. Requires text (used as the playlist's intent). Any sourceText/sourceUrl/sourcePdf/sourceYoutube/style/styleNotes/coachKey are ignored (they only affect AI generation).

voicePerspective.description: Grammatical perspective for the affirmations. 'first_person' = self-talk ("I am focused"); 'second_person' = coach voice ("You are focused"). Only meaningful together with affirmations[] — set it to match the voice you actually wrote in, otherwise the stored perspective may not match your text.

tools.name: nl_playlist_delete
tools.description: Delete a playlist permanently. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: nl_playlist_update
tools.description: Update a playlist's intent text, title, emoji, and/or tone preference. At least one field must be provided.

text.description: New intent text (what you want to practice)

tools.name: nl_playlist_export
tools.description: Export a playlist as a YAML string. Includes title, emoji, intent text, affirmations, and render config. The YAML can be edited and re-imported with nl_playlist_import. With withFramework=true, prepends the framework as markdown for human-facing contexts (the combined output is NOT re-importable via nl_playlist_import — apply expects pure YAML).

withFramework.description: When true, prepend the framework as markdown before the YAML body. Default false (pure YAML, re-importable). Legacy sets without a framework render a fallback notice instead of failing.

tools.name: nl_playlist_import
tools.description: Apply a YAML set file to an existing playlist. Updates title, emoji, affirmations, and render config based on the YAML content. Use nl_playlist_export to get the current YAML first, edit it, then import. Use this (not nl_sync_affirmations) when you need to change the WHOLE playlist — title, emoji, render config, AND affirmations — from a single YAML document. Use nl_sync_affirmations instead when you only need to add/update/remove affirmations via a JSON array and don't need to touch title, emoji, or render config.

yaml.description: YAML content to apply (from nl_playlist_export, edited)
